display.title: Mowzie's Mobs: Frostmaw
display.subtitle: Wake and slay the ice beast
description: High in the snowy peaks sleeps §bFrostmaw§r, a great frost beast guarding a
frozen lair. Strike the icicle it clutches to rouse it, then weather its
roars and swipes until it falls.
§7A frigid Tier 1 hunt — bring fire resistance to the cold and warmth to the heart.
